usage: The word '碼' indicates the size of clothing or shoes.
'碼' is often used with numbers to specify exact sizes, like 'S碼' (Small size), 'M碼' (Medium size).
It can be used in questions to ask about the size, for example, '你幾多碼？' means 'What size are you?'.
'碼' can appear in both singular and plural contexts depending on how it is quantified.
When shopping, '碼' helps to clarify the fit and measurement of apparel or footwear.
